plan.major: Business Administration (Texas Direct Field of Study, UTD track)
plan.notes: NOTE: Dallas College structures this transfer business award as an Associate of ARTS with a Field of Study in Business Administration (degree code AA.TXD.BUSI.ADMIN) — it is not an AS. The Dallas College catalog program page for 2025-2026 (preview_program.php?catoid=4&poid=1691) returned HTTP 403 to the research fetcher, so the complete semester-by-semester course sequence was taken from the official Guided Pathways (GPS) page, which the page itself labels 'Catalog Year 2026-2027'. The GPS page states: 'This is not an official degree plan. See the catalog for official degree requirements.' This is a Texas Direct Field of Study plan approved by the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board; the catalog states it constitutes a 60 semester credit hour transfer block to any public Texas four-year college/university. Course classifications follow the page's labels: '(CB0xx) Core course', 'Field of Study Designated (CB0xx) Core course', 'Field of Study Discipline Foundation Course', 'UTD Directed Elective Field of Study Course'. ECON 2301 is both FOS and CB080 core (category 'core'). 'Must earn a grade of C or higher' on ENGL 1301 and MATH 1324 are graduation rules, not prereqs. No course-level prerequisites are listed on the page.
